rules.text: A change to headings 8001 through 8002 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to heading 8003 from any other heading; or
(B) A change to wire of heading 8003 from within that heading, whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that, if bar or rod is used, the cross-sectional area of the bar or rod is reduced by at least 50 percent.
A change to a good of heading 8007 from any other good within that heading or any other heading.
